texts.title_text: SNL season 52 opens with Jalen Brunson hosting and KATSEYE as musical guest
texts.slide_1_text: KATSEYE makes history as the first all-female group to headline a season premiere musical slot.

texts.slide_3_text: This strategic booking aims to draw audiences with current pop culture powerhouses from the start.
texts.slide_4_text: SNL's 1975 debut featured George Carlin with Billy Preston and Janis Ian as musical acts.
